nodes.label: Demonstration access panel
nodes.rationale: The panel displays demo credentials for Miguel, Rosa and admin and warns that they are for isolated environments only.

nodes.label: Configured token and idle timeouts
nodes.rationale: TOKEN_SECONDS defaults to 86400 seconds and IDLE_SECONDS defaults to 150 seconds.

nodes.label: Unconnected recovery and support
nodes.rationale: The login page shows recovery and contact options but explicitly states that recovery and support are not connected.

nodes.label: PostgreSQL and schema configuration
nodes.rationale: The backend configures a PostgreSQL datasource, enables Flyway, validates the Hibernate schema and disables Open Session in View.

nodes.label: Compose backend service
nodes.rationale: The backend is configured with database and JWT settings and waits for the database health check.

nodes.label: Compose frontend service
nodes.rationale: The frontend exposes port 80 on host port 8080 by default and sets API_UPSTREAM to the backend.

nodes.label: Sign-in form
nodes.rationale: The form accepts a User ID and password, displays validation errors, allows password visibility toggling and supports remembering the User ID.

nodes.label: Login language selector
nodes.rationale: The selector offers English and Filipino; the welcome heading changes with the selected language.
